objective: Implement an offline, read-only delivery manifest planner as the first complete file-delivery vertical slice.

acceptance.behavior: Python >=3.11 package installs locally and exposes file-delivery plan PATH [PATH ...] --root ROOT --json and --help; runtime uses standard library only.

For regular files and nested directories inside an explicit root, return one JSON object: schema_version=1, status=planned, files sorted by root-relative POSIX path with path,size_bytes,sha256, file_count,total_bytes; contents hashed with SHA-256; duplicate and overlapping inputs deduplicated; Unicode and spaces supported.

Reject missing paths with INPUT_NOT_FOUND, any input or traversed descendant symlink with SYMLINK_NOT_ALLOWED, paths outside root with PATH_NOT_ALLOWED, special files with UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE, and no selected regular files with EMPTY_SELECTION. Return exit 2 and JSON status=error,error.code,error.message without a partial success manifest.

Reject sensitive components .git,.ssh,.aws,.kube and basenames .env,.env.*,*.pem,*.key,credentials*,secret* (case-insensitive); explicit root is an existing real directory with no symlink components. Invalid root yields INVALID_ROOT. Reject entire plan rather than silently skipping sensitive files.

Planning reads inputs only: no network, archive, password, upload, mail, state database or input modification. Do not follow directory links. For valid invocation stdout contains only JSON; diagnostics exclude file contents.

IO failures return IO_ERROR and exit 2. Changes observed during hashing via before/after file metadata yield INPUT_CHANGED and exit 2. This detects observed changes, not an adversarial filesystem snapshot guarantee. Test every required behavior with nonempty unittest discovery and clean installation smoke test.
